sources.title: Denis Twitchett and Klaus-Peter Tietze, The Liao, Cambridge History of China
sources.note: Publisher chapter summary directly read; northern power, diplomacy and Cathay etymology. Full chapter not claimed read.

sources.title: Pujiang Liu, The Founding Year of the Khitan Dynasty
sources.note: Primary research article, Journal of Chinese Humanities9(2023),3-23. Read opening discussion of907/916 and conflicting historical accounts, not misleading compressed abstract sentence. Same article Shandong PDF indexed p4 confirms.

sources.title: Pamela Kyle Crossley, What keeps the Kitans enigmatic
sources.note: Direct scholarly fulltext read. Northern/southern administrations near notes82-86; dependent workers and Han Kuangsi near notes96-98. Avoid rigid ethnic binary the article critiques.

sources.title: Hang Lin, The Khitan Empress Dowagers Yingtian and Chengtian
sources.note: Publisher summary directly read, pp183-194 chapter published2018. Describes court women as administrators and military leaders, sometimes sharing power during husband life. Does not establish universal equality.

sources.title: Columbia University Asia for Educators, Northern Rivals
sources.note: Direct module and silver ingot caption read.1005 annual100,000 taels/200,000 bolts; ingot likely tribute only. Do not use the apparent typo in1042 silver figure.

sources.title: Princeton University Art Museum, Liao Dynasty Coffin Panels
sources.note: Direct complete page and panel descriptions read:1995-90 banquet;1995-87 women; Other Liao Dynasty Coffin Panels, figures at doorway.10th-early11th-century funerary scenes, idealized and likely coffin construction.

sources.title: University of Michigan Museum of Art, Flask1993/1.101.1-2
sources.note: Direct catalogue, descriptions and physical description read. Lead-glazed ceramic, leather prototype, kumis interpretation, pierced strap lugs. Catalogue whole-dynasty dating907-1125 retained as range.

sources.title: Lothar Ledderose, Carving Sutras into Stone before the Catastrophe
sources.note: Proceedings of the British Academy125(2004),381-454. Direct full PDF text; local downloaded PDF rendered to inspect p385 Fig2 first panel rightmost column, original雲居寺; English title translation p449. p3844080 slabs1093-1095/buried1117; p392 printed Qidan canon; p449 Jin continuation. No invented Khitan sample.

sources.title: China National Commission for UNESCO, Wooden Structures of Liao Dynasty
sources.note: Original national Tentative List submission29January2013, hosted UNESCO. Built1056,67.31m, octagonal double-shell structure and joinery; Fengguo Hall1020. It is a tentative-list proposal, not a World Heritage inscription.

sources.title: Metropolitan Museum of Art, Arhat (Luohan),21.76
sources.note: Direct original catalogue. Ca1000, life-size, three-color-glazed stoneware.1983 kiln material supports date; Yixian cave provenance only thought, not secure.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica, Qara Khetay
sources.note: Direct scholarly entry read, Yelu Dashi Chinese/Khitan education,1125 capture of last Liao emperor and migration west. Treat Western Liao as a successor with a separate geographic history.
